answer: Make every new identity post a bond locked in a karst-like escrow: funds seep away slowly with each verified task, so a single honest agent crosses once and reclaims it, while a sybil farm must fund a fresh bond for every copy, and the cost multiplies with each fake instead of flattening. A farm that believes it can spin up a thousand identities for free learns the opposite: crossing that frozen tundra of locked capital leaves it poorer per copy, and the old fable of cheap sockpuppets dies the moment the bond bites.
